svg.title: Build an understanding that people and agents can keep developing.
svg.desc: Illustrative supplier decision: Choose a dependable supplier. Customer orders need a supplier we can rely on, so compare quotes and check performance on real orders. Use Company A for every order. Both suppliers’ samples passed inspection, so we chose A at $8.20/unit over B at $10. That choice assumed A’s five-day delivery estimate was reliable. The later delivery review ruled out A for urgent orders. Review Company A’s deliveries. Three of five orders arrived late. Two delayed customer shipments. The lower price no longer justifies relying on A for urgent work. Trial Company B for urgent orders. A’s delivery review exposed missed customer deadlines. B quotes three days, but its delivery performance remains untested. Trial 100 units with B. Keep A for flexible orders. Check Company B’s trial results. No trial results yet. Check delivery dates and quality before giving B more orders.
